scenicChapters.title: Adriatic Highway, Jadranska Magistrala
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 35 km this is Adriatic Highway, Jadranska Magistrala, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-natural-and-culturo-historical-re.story: From Tivat it runs 356 km to Tivat; allow about 6 h 08 of riding. The stops in between: Lokrum Island, Vjetrenica Cave, Stećci Medieval Tombstone Graveyards and Bijača. It crosses Montenegro, Croatia and Bosnia & Herzegovina - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
